by: council registers fork of integrator-9d788fb (proposed; the integrator appends at the merge)
title: A council's register (or one member's return) of members' pecuniary interests as a PDF with a text layer, read by the text reader

landmarks: a usable text layer (support.docread.pages.read_from is not pixels)
its text names pecuniary interests, an interests register, a register of (members') interests, a declaration of interest, or s 54E (model_read.MARKERS)

signals.measured_on: the 370 held register PDFs with a text layer, 2 November 2026
signals.no_marker_note: six Christchurch lists of council appointments to outside bodies (not registers: set aside at read); Kapiti's tables and two mixed files whose first pages have no text

ocr: a PDF with no usable text layer waits for the page reader (17 of 387 held, 2 November 2026); a mixed PDF's thin pages are named unread
prompt: registers.councillor_interests.model_read.PROMPT (its hash in the reading's settings): each member, role, every category as printed typed by its s 54E kind, entries as printed; real property's entries never copied; no address, road, email or phone; no spouse's or partner's interests

reading.measured: the budget is the answer's: a register's answer is about as long as its text (ten councils' PDFs, 2 November 2026: 12,567 characters in, 12,046 out; 16,951 in, 14,672 out); every answer over about 14,500 characters was cut at 4,096 tokens and unusable (five of ten at a 34,000 budget); 12,000 keeps the answer under it and the request far under the context

notes: Never kept, whatever the model answers: a category typed real property or whose heading names real property, land, a home, an address or a contact; a spouse's or partner's interests; an entry shaped like a street address, a road or highway, a rural delivery, a title reference, an email or a phone number (model_read.kept, read.WITHHELD, read.PRIVATE_PERSON). Counted by heading only. The stored reading carries none of them either (model_read._store_parsed).
applies_to: councils' register documents held by registers/councillor_interests, from 2 November 2026
process: Take the text layer by page
Pack whole pages into pieces up to the budget, a larger page cut at line ends
Read each piece with the text reader; store by hash and piece
The load replays, filters and keeps
gates: A register marker in the text
on_fail: no text layer: waits for the page reader; no marker: set aside at read as not a register; no usable answer after two attempts: the piece is stored as set aside

by: council registers fork of integrator-9d788fb (proposed; the integrator appends at the merge)
title: A council's web page that prints its register of members' pecuniary interests in a shape the clause-row grammar does not read, read by the text reader

landmarks: at least 2,000 characters of text with scripts, styles, navigation, header and footer removed
at least 5 mentions of pecuniary interests, an interests register, a declaration of interest or s 54E (model_read.MARKERS)

signals.measured_on: the held landing pages of the councils with no register found, 2 November 2026

reading.split: parts of whole lines of 8,000 characters, packed as pages

notes: The same never-kept rules as interests-register-pdf-text.
applies_to: councils' register pages held by registers/councillor_interests, from 2 November 2026
process: Take the page's text by block
Cut into parts of whole lines
Read as the PDF profile reads
gates: Long enough and naming the register often enough
on_fail: a page that does not pass is a landing page, not read
